column3: Close to the Greek; “soudarion” is rendered “handkerchief.”
NKJV lacks “in Hebrew,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “My Father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Father.” “Do not touch Me” is rendered “Do not cling to Me.”
NKJV has “told,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text reads “announced … ‘I have seen the Lord.’”
NKJV renders the name “Didymus” by its meaning, “the Twin.”
NKJV includes “Thomas,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
